import itertools
import string
import pandas as pd

def task_func():
    # Generate all possible 3-letter combinations from the lowercase English alphabet
    combinations = list(itertools.product(string.ascii_lowercase, repeat=3))

    # Create a DataFrame from the combinations
    df = pd.DataFrame(combinations, columns=["first_letter", "second_letter", "third_letter"])

    # Count frequency of the first letters in the combinations
    first_letter_counts = df["first_letter"].value_counts().sort_index()

    # Plot histogram-like bar chart of first-letter frequencies
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    first_letter_counts.plot(kind="bar", ax=ax)
    ax.set_xlabel("First letter")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.set_title("Frequency of First Letters in 3-Letter Combinations")

    return df, ax
